+from fastapi import FastAPI, APIRouter
+from fastapi.routing import BaseRoute, _EffectiveRouteContext
+
+def test_iter_route_contexts():
+    app = FastAPI()
+    router = APIRouter(prefix="/users")
+    
+    @router.get("/me")
+    async def read_me():
+        return {"user": "me"}
+    
+    @router.get("/profile")
+    async def read_profile():
+        return {"user": "profile"}
+    
+    app.include_router(router)
+    
+    @app.get("/root")
+    async def read_root():
+        return {"message": "root"}
+    
+    # Test on app (FastAPI inherits from APIRouter)
+    contexts = list(app.iter_route_contexts())
+    
+    # We expect 3 routes: /root, /users/me, /users/profile
+    assert len(contexts) == 3
+    
+    # Check if we have the routes and their contexts
+    # /root should have None context because it's directly on the app
+    # /users/me and /users/profile should have _EffectiveRouteContext
+    
+    root_route = next(r for r, c in contexts if r.path == "/root")
+    root_context = next(c for r, c in contexts if r.path == "/root")
+    assert root_context is None
+    
+    me_route = next(r for r, c in contexts if r.path == "/users/me")
+    me_context = next(c for r, c in contexts if r.path == "/users/me")
+    assert isinstance(me_context, _EffectiveRouteContext)
+    assert me_context.original_route == me_route
+    
+    profile_route = next(r for r, c in contexts if r.path == "/users/profile")
+    profile_context = next(c for r, c in contexts if r.path == "/users/profile")
+    assert isinstance(profile_context, _EffectiveRouteContext)
+    assert profile_context.original_route == profile_route
+
+    # Test on router
+    router_contexts = list(router.iter_route_contexts())
+    assert len(router_contexts) == 2
+    for r, c in router_contexts:
+        assert c is None # Because they are directly on this router, not included in another
+
+    print("All tests passed!")
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    test_iter_route_contexts()
